scope: Sample economic/financial registry for Reagan and George H.W. Bush FRUS annotation sheets. Use it to keep dollar amounts, percentages, debt metrics, IMF/World Bank terminology, MDB and GAB references, Paris Club and Baker Plan language, Eximbank/OPIC/ESF/AID program labels, budget claims, and debt-relief mechanics tied to published FRUS examples before allowing direct edits.

records.approved_phrase: A 47 percent increase in resources has been approved
records.policy_context: IMF quota increase and LDC debt situation in a SIG-IEP meeting.
records.public_or_archival_basis: Published FRUS text gives the approved percentage before listing U.S. and GAB amounts.

records.approved_phrase: the U.S. portion of which is $5.8 billion
records.policy_context: U.S. share of IMF resource increase.
records.public_or_archival_basis: Published FRUS text records the exact U.S. portion of the IMF increase.

records.approved_phrase: The GAB arrangement will be increased to $19 billion
records.policy_context: GAB expansion from G-10 availability to all member countries.
records.public_or_archival_basis: Published FRUS text identifies GAB amount and access change.
variant_forms: General Arrangements to Borrow increased to $19 billion

records.approved_phrase: ask Congress for a total of $8.4 billion
records.policy_context: Total request to Congress for IMF quota and GAB resources.
records.public_or_archival_basis: Published FRUS text gives the combined congressional request figure.

records.public_or_archival_basis: Published FRUS text gives the start figure, estimated end figure, and year.
